indicator_name: Employees separated during the quarter, by region (form 1-Т, excluding small enterprises)
description: Выбыло работников за квартал, по регионам (форма 1-Т, без малых предприятий)
methodology: Taldau 703003, 2016 Q1 onward (quarterly data were not compiled 2013-2015). National 2026 Q2: 278 717. With VACANCIES_BY_REGION_QUARTERLY's HIRED gives the hiring and separation rates of enterprises other than small.
